title: Inverse Reasoning Models for Efficient Post-Training and Verification from Answer-Only Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.18878v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training reasoning LLMs often requires making a tradeoff between costly supervision and compute inefficiency: supervised finetuning typically requires reasoning traces, which is data inefficient since in many applications one only has prompt-answer tuples and lacks the groundtruth chain-of-thought (CoT) sequence. On the other hand, reinforcement learning (with verifiable rewards, for example) can operate without CoT data but it is much more compute-inefficient since it requires multiple autoregressive completions per optimization step, none of which are guaranteed to give a non-zero policy gradient. In this work we explore a middleground, a self-distillation technique that uses answer-only data, treating CoT as latent variables. This relies on training a partner ``inverse reasoning LLM" that generates the original's reasoning traces conditioned on the answer. translated_title: 基于仅答案数据的高效后训练与验证的逆向推理模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.18878v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：对推理型大语言模型进行后训练通常需要在昂贵的监督与低效的计算之间做出权衡：监督微调通常需要推理轨迹，这在数据上是低效的，因为在许多应用场景中，人们只有提示-答案对，而缺乏真实的思维链（CoT）序列。另一方面，强化学习（例如使用可验证奖励的方法）虽然可以在没有CoT数据的情况下运行，但在计算上却低效得多，因为它在每次优化步骤中都需要进行多次自回归生成，而这些生成无法保证产生非零的策略梯度。在本工作中，我们探索了一种折中方案——一种仅使用答案数据的自蒸馏技术，将思维链视为隐变量。这依赖于训练一个配套的“逆向推理大语言模型”，该模型能够根据答案生成原始模型的推理轨迹。该逆向模型只需训练一次，即可在后续传入的各个批次中重复使用……
tldr: 该论文提出一种自蒸馏方法，通过训练一个“逆向推理模型”根据答案反向生成推理轨迹，从而仅利用提示-答案对数据即可高效后训练推理大语言模型，在数据效率与计算效率之间取得平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-distillation approach that trains an "inverse reasoning model" to generate reasoning traces backward from answers, enabling efficient post-training of reasoning LLMs using only prompt-answer data, striking a balance between data efficiency and compute efficiency.
